title: metadata save door: a hand-authored `_lock` binds on an environment item with no unlock door (any manage_metadata holder can brick an item); ADR-0010 §3.5 and the spec say the key is never authored; needs a ruling
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (b): a private runtime key that authors can set at a public door, with no way back. `reach:` the public door, measured on a showcase boot at `abf86554c9` by #23096's dev:
- `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/probe_rawlock_app` with `{ name, label, _lock: 'full', _lockReason: 'raw' }` answers 200;
- `GET` then reads `lock: 'full'`, `editable: false`, `deletable: false`;
- a second `PUT` answers `403 ITEM_LOCKED` ("locked (_lock=full, source=overlay)"), and `DELETE` answers `403 ITEM_LOCKED`.

No unlock door exists (ADR-0010 §3.8 is unimplemented). So any `manage_metadata` holder, or an AI copying the `_lock` that a served packaged body carries, can make an environment item permanently uneditable and undeletable through the API.

Filed by `domain:engine` seat 2 (#20966) · `os-steve` · `session_01ADzJtzYTLUfgrRZHxkagkX` · 2026-10-13T00:47Z. It comes from #23096's dev (os-dev-report 6135259274, out-of-scope findings) and the contract-tier record on PR #23115 (6135514431). ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

## The texts that disagree
- ADR-0010 §3.5: "Tenant `org` artifacts ignore L3 / L4 entirely (the tenant owns them in full, can also delete them)."
- `packages/spec/src/shared/protection.zod.ts`'s guidance: "The `_lock*` keys are the runtime's PRIVATE envelope, stamped by the loader from this block — never authored."
- But `item-lock.ts` (`resolveOverlayLockLayer`) cites the triage ruling on #21738, which calls a stored row lock "an administrator's stored lock". So a stored-lock door may be intended. If so, it is undeclared, authorised by nothing beyond `manage_metadata`, and has no unlock.
- The save door's `DERIVED_PROVENANCE_KEYS` deliberately omits `_lock*`.

## Why this needs a ruling, not a fix
A refusal at the save door would reverse the #21738 reading. Honouring the stored lock would need a declared door, an authorisation, and an unlock door (ADR-0010 §3.8). This is a contract choice, so it goes to triage for routing and, if the readings stand, to the decision box.

## Related
#23096 (PR #23115) closes the same door for the public `protection` block: refused at save, per ADR-0010.

Dedupe: raw _lock save door bricks environment item; hand-authored _lock overlay binds no unlock; _lock envelope authored at metadata save door; org item lock ADR-0010 §3.5. A search of the issues found #21738 (the ruling cited above) and no open card for this reach.
